motions.item_title: A Resolution of Eagle Mountain City, Utah, Extending an Offer for the Position of City Manager and Authorizing the Mayor to Negotiate an Employment Agreement.
motions.motion: Councilmember Wood moved to adopt a Resolution of Eagle Mountain City, Utah, Extending an Offer for the Position of City Manager and Authorizing the Eagle Mountain City Special Council Meeting – July 27, 2024 Page 1 of 2 Mayor to Negotiate an Employment Agreement. Councilmember Wright seconded the motion.
motions.headline: City manager job offered to a candidate
motions.summary: The council extended a job offer for the city manager position and authorized the mayor to negotiate the employment agreement.
motions.impact: Nothing changes for you day to day, but the city manager is the top staff official who runs city operations, so this sets who will oversee the services you use. The motion does not name the candidate or the pay.
